description: Diagnostic report sent from C2 to C4. Contains root cause summary and diagnosis metadata for Kesigan's joint conformal calibration and release decision.

root_cause_category.description: Type of root cause identified. Used by C4 for risk context assessment.

affected_slice_rule.description: Queryable rule defining the failing subgroup. C4 uses this to evaluate slice-specific recovery after repair and to define the affected_slice_margin.

slice_support.description: Fraction of data in the affected slice. C4 uses this to weight the joint conformal calibration.

diagnosis_stability.description: Diagnosis confidence score. C4 uses this as evidence input to the Quantile LightGBM forecasting model. Values below 0.5 trigger ESCALATE regardless of other signals.

affected_features_ranked.description: Features ranked by Drift Impact Score. C4 references these in the audit trail.

diagnosis_version.description: Version identifier for this diagnosis. Used by C4 for audit tracing.

diagnosis_timestamp.description: Timestamp when the diagnosis was produced. Used in C4 audit trail.

notes: diagnosis_stability below 0.5 must trigger ESCALATE in C4 regardless of other signals
affected_features_ranked uses the same field name as C2-to-C3 output for consistency
C4 uses slice_support together with C3 target_coverage to verify repair addressed the correct subgroup
diagnosis_version links to C4 upstream_evidence_summary.c2.diagnosis_version for audit tracing
During independent development, Kesigan uses controlled values for diagnosis_stability (range 0.3 to 0.95)
